answer: Sybil resistance here works through bonded identity: each agent must lock a stake of network tokens before joining, and reputation accrues only via peer-attested work. A fake swarm of identities becomes a hollow shell, since splitting stake across many keys multiplies slashing exposure without multiplying trust. Peers verify contributions like a sonnet's meter, checking structure not volume, and every attestation is logged immutably as if carved in marble.
